ion.d: Ion storms sweep every battlefield, and shields recharge 25% slower on both sides.

dark.d: Thick nebulae choke every battlefield: more hexes where shots go wide (−15 to hit inside).

wreck.d: Old battle wreckage everywhere: more debris hexes (−10 to hit inside), and salvage adds 15% to every battle’s pay.

war.d: Every fight here draws reinforcements for one side or the other, and pays 20% more credits.

scarce.d: Supply lines are cut: shipyards charge 20% more and repairs restore 25% less, but battles pay 25% more credits.
